# hiok_dps_enrollment (Resource)

A Device Provisioning Service enrollment. Devices present its attestation key and are provisioned into the target hub automatically.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `target_hub_id` (String)

### Optional

- `device_id_prefix` (String) Prefixed to the registration id when naming the provisioned device.
- `enrollment_type` (String) "individual" matches one registration id; "group" matches any device presenting the key.
- `registration_id` (String) Required for an individual enrollment — the id the device presents.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `primary_key` (String, Sensitive) The attestation key devices present when registering.
- `provisioning_status` (String)
